summary: Accept hotfix decision for context-reset handoff result visibility

diff_table.current_state: Tool-context `context-reset` session handoffs can auto-queue `/wiki-session-handoff`, causing command-context `ctx.compact()` to run immediately and hide the tool result.
diff_table.desired_state: Tool-context `context-reset` handoffs must stage durable refs and return a visible command/result without auto-queueing immediate compaction; command-context compaction runs only after the result is visible.
diff_table.rationale: Direct or immediate compaction from a tool path can erase the tool response and block the agent loop even though the handoff artifact is valid.
diff_table.risk: Low-to-medium: changes Pi adapter queue timing for context-reset only while preserving command executor and new-session behavior.
diff_table.user_action: User identified this as a blocker bug and asked to proceed.

accepted_decisions.summary: Context-reset handoff auto-queue is disabled from tool context; new-session auto-queue remains allowed.
